headline: Anthropic expands Claude access across all government levels via GSA
body: Anthropic announced an expanded partnership with the General Services Administration to make Claude available to federal, state, and local government agencies. This move signals mainstream adoption of large language models in public sector workflows, including healthcare systems operated by government entities. Healthcare AI deployments in VA hospitals, state Medicaid programs, and public health departments could now incorporate Claude for documentation, clinical decision support, and administrative tasks. For healthcare consultants, this represents a significant shift in the vendor landscape: government procurement pathways are opening for AI tools that previously relied on direct enterprise channels. Agencies must now evaluate Claude alongside existing EHR-integrated solutions and assess compliance requirements for clinical AI in regulated settings.
